visuals.heading: Mbb Vs Big 4 Vs Boutique: What

rows: Highest brand pull, highest pay, most selective process. Work spans corporate strategy, large-scale transformation, and CEO-level advisory. Hiring runs mostly through top-tier B-school and undergrad campuses, plus a narrow experienced-hire track for specialists.
Tier-2 strategy firms (Kearney, Oliver Wyman, L.E.K., Roland Berger, EY-Parthenon, Strategy&)
Similar case-based hiring bar, narrower campus reach, often faster path to real client ownership since teams are smaller. Strong landing spot if MBB does not work out.
Big 4 consulting arms (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG)

Largest hiring volume by far, broadest entry pool including direct-from-degree hires, wide range of work from strategy to technology and operations delivery. Pay is lower than MBB but the door is far wider and internal mobility across practice areas is real.

Smaller teams built around one industry or function (healthcare, pharma pricing, supply chain, public sector). Less brand recognition outside the sector, but often deeper, faster-paced client exposure and less internal bureaucracy than large firms.
